question.text: Open position limits at the client level for commodity index futures are:

answer.text: 5% of open interest or 1,000 lots, whichever is higher
10% of open interest or 2,000 lots, whichever is higher
15% of open interest or 10,000 lots, whichever is higher
3% of open interest or 500 lots, whichever is higher

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook p.41, client-level position limits for index futures are 5% of open interest or 1,000 lots, whichever is higher. The Trap: 10%/2,000 lots is for index OPTIONS at client level (double of futures, per workbook p.45). 15%/10,000 is at member level, not client. 3%/500 is not a specified limit. Note: Index options client-level limits are double those of index futures (10% of OI or 2,000 lots).
